body: DEPENDENCY IMPLICATION, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION FINDING. The chief's f3fa78e remedy is authority-correct: remove or defer public HumanAdjudication, FixtureReview, AdmittedViewEvidence issuance, and evidence-assisted decode until an actual governed verifier or issuer exists; retain ValidatedBuild as the positive root. But this makes the next output successor a SAFE PARTIAL implementation, not full output-contract or product-vertical completion. The accepted spec at section 8 requires fixture basis only through an admitted fixture path and human basis only with its adjudication receipt; C6 requires distinct fixture, acquired-build, and human roots; the accepted product successor still requires a separate admitted fixture/provider semantic route. Therefore do not relabel a repository fixture as ValidatedBuild, do not mark fixture/human C6 complete with refusal-only tests, and do not claim the validated fixture CLI route is unblocked. Preserve source-only Semantics not established now; record the governed issuer/verifier as an explicit follow-on dependency before fixture/human semantic output can be called complete. If an existing issuer already establishes that authority, name it and bind the court to it; otherwise deferral must remain visible. No reserved implementation path inspected.
